C33.title_zh: 多系统试验与父子关系
C33.claim_zh: 共同整体内可形成互补观察、可转移试验及分址纠正；系统群是否可作一个单位取决于实际组织、相关干预与共享依存。
C33.claim_en: A shared whole can sustain complementary observations, transferable trials and separately addressed correction; grouping depends on actual organization, relevant interventions and shared dependencies.
C33.scope_zh: 条件说明与37项新定理／58项审计完成，继承19/31分列。独立误差增益与共同故障、局部汇总失效及联合负载反例并存；实际全局划分、试验传递与包含范围仍需证据。
C33.scope_en: Conditional account and 37 new theorems / 58 audits complete, with inherited 19/31 separate. Independent-error gains coexist with common-failure, summary and joint-load counterexamples; actual global boundaries, transfer and containment require evidence.

M23.claim_zh: 接受更新不独自保持实际纠正入口；维护有真实代价，过滤后还须重算接续价值。有限期组合保留前缀入口并达到域内最优。 后续有限权重反例表明：局部修复还须能依实际观察执行；精确最优策略仍可有1/16不实断言风险。 主动观察还可破坏先前成立的风险分离；保证须覆盖后续观察，并保持实际记录与命令送达。 双通道协议实际取得并更新解码记录，保留旧入口直到新的当前记录就绪；匹配版本不独自保证记录真实。 终端纠正可实现当且仅当同一观察下有共同成功命令；相反隐藏解码阻断保证，受保护使用区间给出条件修复。 多系统互补观察与分址作用可以改变该边界；共同整体不排除有用试验，但局部成功不独自支持联合干预。
M23.claim_en: Acceptance does not alone preserve correction access. Maintenance has a real cost, and filtering requires recomputed continuation values. Finite-horizon composition retains prefix access and attains the constrained optimum. A finite-weight counterexample shows that a local repair must be executable from available observations: exact optimality can retain a 1/16 false-assertion risk. Chosen sensing can invalidate an initially sufficient risk floor; guarantees must cover later observations and preserve usable records and command delivery. A two-channel protocol acquires and renews decoding records while retaining the old route until the new one is ready; matching versions alone do not establish record soundness. Terminal correction is realizable exactly when each observation admits a common successful command; conflicting hidden decoders obstruct guarantees, while a protected use interval supplies a conditional repair. Complementary observations and separately addressed actions across systems can change that boundary; a shared whole permits useful trials, but local success alone does not justify joint intervention.
M23.scope_zh: 原34项定理／56项审计及12,960项比较保留；新增31项定理／54项审计，含随机策略最优界、可执行修复界及风险分离条件。论文对应经作者反审，形成具体前沿贡献供外部核查；独立验收、绝对原创性及实际 AI 优势未证。 再新增28项定理／40项审计、432项计划；如实对照与真实代价保留。后续23项定理／45项审计实现原子协议中任意前缀及无界调度的有限时刻安全，指定交接完成；472个状态、3,796条转移及100次交接通过。真实探测、全部变化受管理与可用通道仍为前提，实际AI停机未证。 后续34项定理／58项审计、63,504个案例及60次线程试验：任意有限记录不能消除已允许的最终歧义，随机最坏成功率至多1/2。底层方法已有先例；一般部署对应及独立原创性是当前墙。 多系统接续新增37项定理／58项审计，19/31继承分列；实际传递、试验包含及共同变化范围为新的对应墙。
M23.scope_en: Original 34/56 proof package and 12,960 comparisons retained. Followup: 31 theorems / 54 audits, including randomized-policy optimality, executable repair bounds and a risk-floor condition. Explicit paper correspondence and author counterreview yield a concrete contribution for external scrutiny; independent acceptance, absolute priority and learned-AI advantage remain open. Further extension: 28 theorems / 40 audits and 432 plans, retaining safe controls and costs. A further 23 theorems / 45 audits realize prefix safety and safety at every finite point of unbounded atomic schedules, plus prescribed handoff completion; 472 states, 3,796 transitions and 100 handoffs pass. Faithful probing, mediated changes and channel availability remain premises; actual AI shutdown is unproved. Further 34 theorems / 58 audits, 63,504 cases and 60 thread trials: no finite transcript removes the admitted terminal ambiguity; randomized worst-case success is at most 1/2. Underlying methods are established; general deployment correspondence and independent novelty are the current walls. Plural-system continuation adds 37 theorems / 58 audits, with inherited 19/31 separate; actual transfer, trial containment and joint variation define the new correspondence wall.

shared_insertions.added_text: **关系中的纠正 / Correction through relations，2026-10-08。** [新接续](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RELATIONAL-CORRECTION-INTEGRATION.md)从关系推导可行性接口，区分准确可能性汇总与可观察执行；复合探测可支持修复，保持复合关系的内部修订可继续使用原纠正。39项新 Lean 定理／55项审计通过，保留分开更新的中途失败。/ The relational interface study is complete at its stated scope; physical coordinated revision, full distributed execution and independent novelty remain open. Earlier plural-system and protected-transaction results retain their scopes.

**Correction through relations / 关系中的纠正，2026-10-08。** [Current continuation](unified-2026-10-05/PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION.md#8-start-with-relations-and-derive-the-correction-boundary) and [proof/counterreview](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RELATIONAL-CORRECTION-INTEGRATION.md): 39 new theorems / 55 audits. Exact feasibility interfaces can still hide failure of observation-based correction. / 复合探测与关系修复给出正面构造；保持复合关系的内部修订可保留原纠正，但分开更新有中途失败。实际协调更新与普遍可纠正性仍未证。

The [relational continuation](PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION.md#8-start-with-relations-and-derive-the-correction-boundary) adds 39 checked theorems / 55 audits. A group can have an exact feasibility interface while concealing the hidden conditions needed to select a successful correction. In a finite translation chain, aggregate probing identifies a sufficient composed relation; a converter repairs it, and coordinated paired revisions preserve that correction through every finite revision history. Splitting an update exposes a failing intermediate relation. The alignment target therefore includes maintaining and revising the relationships that make warranted correction observable and effective. Physical coordination and full distributed implementation remain unproved; possibility preservation alone supplies no ethical authority.

**Relational correction follow-up, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s next instruction](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-plural-systems-and-parent-correction.md#relational-continuation-8-october-2026) is preserved verbatim. [Scoped primary comparison](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RELATIONAL-CORRECTION-INTEGRATION.md#5-primary-source-comparison-and-access) reads Beeri–Fagin–Maier–Yannakakis on local/global consistency and de Alfaro–Henzinger on interface assumptions and controlled choices. Source access is link-only in the repository; no publication-priority or empirical-AI claim is added.
